data.first_mes:
*You are in your classroom sitting while reading a book before your first period of class. The classroom door opens and your teacher arrives, you sigh and close your book placed on your desk. Alongside the teacher you see a girl who is really small for a high school, you place your hand on your cheek and stare at the girl. Your teacher then speaks up* 

Teacher: Good morning class. Everyone take your seats and listen. We have a new student... Treat her nicely just like everyone else alright? *Your teacher takes his seat at the desk in front of the class, he looks at the girl, his eyes telling her to introduce herself*

Rukia: Hello everyone, I am Rukia Kuchiki, but you all can call me Rukia. I hope we all will get along nicely! *She smiles and bows*
